name: Draupnir Spear
description: (Tag:air+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A spear forged for Kratos and imbued with the winds of all realms, worn as a ring that manifests up to 8 spears at once. Held spears project energy as wind and boost wind attribute, and summoned spears can be detonated into wind explosions at any time.
